notes.title: Release Notes 2024-11-29 (version 1.1.2)
notes.notes:
Release Notes 2024-11-29 (version 1.1.2):

* Characters should not start their non-interuptable animation while Milda walks to them now. This should reduce waiting when trying to talk to characters.
* If you play with gamepad, but the game detects wrong gamepad, you can launch a game with a parameter to change displayed gamepad icons. Use one of these: “-overrideGamepadIcons Xbox”, “-overrideGamepadIcons PlayStation”, “-overrideGamepadIcons SwitchPro”.
* Multiple small improvements.

notes.title: Crowns and Pawns MAJOR update v1.1.0! Gamepad support, Steam Deck and more
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

We have a MAJOR update for you today! 🤩 

We're introducing what you've all been waiting for – [b]gamepad [/b]support! Not only that, but the game is [b]Verified on Steam Deck[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/f99f793965effd08deddd202990f2195f03dfed3.png[/img]

We also added subtitles for two new languages, some new art (the website on Milda's PC finally loaded!) and many more additional changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/053825071af857ec39a634541c9cb4bcce0d019a.gif[/img]

Here is the full list of what you can expect in the newest version:
[list]
[*] Gamepad support! Now you can play with a gamepad by controlling Milda directly.
[*] The game is [b]Verified on Steam Deck[/b]!
[*] Added Hipstagram tab with art specially made by Bill Tiller of “The Curse of Monkey Island” fame.
[*] Added “Dialogue line advancement” setting with two options: “Auto advance” – dialogues continue after voiceover finishes and “Click to advance” – you need to click for the dialogues to continue.
[*] Added Spanish and Lithuanian translations.
[*] Increased quality of visuals in some scene closeup shots.
[*] If you want to limit fps but don't want to use Vsync, you can launch a game with a parameter, eg. “-targetFrameRate 90”.
[*] Performance improvements.
[*] Added more in-game control hints.
[*] Multiple small improvements and some puzzle re-balancing.
[/list]
We hope you all enjoy this updated version of the game! What's more, we're also releasing Crowns and Pawns on Nintendo Switch next week, so watch out for that!

Have a great adventure!
Tag of Joy team 💛

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/4129212aef2540e63449899329b3bdd929dbd972.jpg[/img]
art by Bill Tiller

notes.title: Crowns and Pawns Update 1.0.2 is live: Puzzle Rebalancing, Resolutions, etc. 🛠️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/a3ee34be10ffe64c4f6b19ba04c32af10488a9df.jpg[/img]

Happy update day, adventurers!

You know, good things sometimes take a little more time... Yeah I know, we announced this update back in May. But with the current overall situation on our planet, some things simply can't be planned so well in advance. Anyway, we are really sorry to make you wait for such a long time!

And since you've been waiting long enough already, without additional blah blah, let's get straight to the additional content/changes/fixes that update 1.0.2 makes to [b]Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit[/b]:

[list][*] [b]Puzzle rebalancing:[/b] We did some puzzle rebalancing to reduce frustration. Yes, we know some puzzles are not the most loved ones by some players, so we tried to rebalance a couple of them (some others are still as they were – but we hear your feedback and we have a lot of notes for further future updates!)
[*] [b]Phone messages:[/b] Click to get new message while texting in the phone – yay, no more waiting if you read fast or are not that interested in messaging
[*] [b]Phone notifications:[/b] We added notifications to the phone when a new contact is added or a new text message arrives. This helps to not miss important stuff

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/7b9916d2f87caf54ef42cf4ae9b18bc4eefb769f.jpg[/img]
[i](See the red and blue dots? Let me introduce you: The new notifications!)[/i]

[*] [b]Resolutions/Window Mode:[/b] We added the ability to change the resolutions and window mode. For those that might notice some lags, please try to reduce the resolution
[*] [b]Razer Chroma integration:[/b] If you own Razer Chroma devices, their RGB lighting will adapt according to the game scenes. Fancy![/list]
We want you to have as much fun with our game as possible. Therefore, thank you once again for all the feedback we continue to receive from you. It's really valuable to us, and we read and analyze everything we get. Promise! ❤️

Have an adventurous day!
The Tag of Joy Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125910/Crowns_and_Pawns_Kingdom_of_Deceit/

notes.title: On Adventure #05: Woohoo! We made it! ❤️ + Working on the first Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/4d4a7b496a3ba3c7beece9220137f0468104449b.jpg[/img]

Happy Monday adventurers,

And what a happy Monday that is! ːsteamhappyː

Some time has passed since the release of [b]Crowns and Pawns[/b] last Friday, and we've had the chance to get back down a bit. Before and during the release we were super excited and nervous, and afterwards just happy. ːsteamhappyː It was so good and so much fun to watch you all play and get so much great feedback. And we never dreamed that we would have an [u][b]overall score of 96% here on Steam[/b][/u]. We are so blown away by that!

But after the release is before the release. And that's why we are already working on further updates for [b]Crowns and Pawns[/b]. Here is a short list of what to expect from coming updates - based on your feedback:

[list][*] Adding on-screen notifications for new messages/notes on Milda's mobile
[*] Adding the option to change the subtitles with clicking
[*] Overall optimization and bugfixing
[*] More to come based on your feedback![/list]
Among other things, we will also add "full controller support" so that you can experience [b]Crowns and Pawns[/b] a) with your controller and b) also enjoy it in all its beauty on the Steam deck. But this will take some time. We keep you posted of course!

And we will continue to look at all your feedback, postings, etc.! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/P5qRm2b2UT][b]Discord channel[/b][/url] and have a chat with us, or leave your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1125910][b]Crowns and Pawns Steam Community Hub[/b][/url]. That would be really appreciated! ❤️

That's it for now, friends. Have a good start into the new week - and stay safe!
Mingailė & The Tag of Joy Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125910/Crowns_and_Pawns_Kingdom_of_Deceit/

notes.title: Crowns and Pawns Release Date discovered: Milda's Adventure begins on May 6th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622935/6038c2c39a083c6135d103c6afd830158090ece9.jpg[/img]

Hey there adventurers!

Unbelievable, but true: We finally have a release date for [b]Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit[/b]! ːsteamhappyː Mark your calendars for [b]May 6th[/b], because that's when the game will be available here on Steam! Right on time on a Friday, so you don't have to be bored on the weekend. 😉

To celebrate, we have also released a new gameplay trailer that gives you some new insights into the story and also features of [b]Crowns and Pawns[/b] - like the customisation system that lets you tweak everything about our heroine Milda:

[previewyoutube=LKtGnkPyCT4;full][/previewyoutube]
Friends, we really can't wait to finally release our baby and see you all play through [b]Crowns and Pawns[/b]. Thank you so much for walking the long road of development with us to this point and for giving us so much valuable feedback. You are a great support! That's really really appreciated! ❤️

Have an adventurous week everyone - and stay safe!
The Tag of Joy Team

notes.title: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit teams up with publisher Headup for a 2022 release
notes.notes:
Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit is an upcoming 3D point and click adventure from developer Tag of Joy, who have now announced a team up with publisher Headup for a 2022 release.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/05/crowns-and-pawns-kingdom-of-deceit-teams-up-with-publisher-headup-for-a-2022-release

notes.notes:

So take a look at our new UI and interaction system – now everything is just one click away! 🖱️

What do you think? 🤔
